description: Ski resorts whose own lift board lists running lifts right now, most open lifts first, optionally within a region (a country such as "Chile", a state such as "Colorado", a season pass such as "Ikon Pass" or "Epic Pass", or any tag from ski_list_regions). Uses the latest check of every resort, made about every 90 minutes, so it answers "where can I ski today?" across all resorts at once; each line gives its as-of time. Use ski_get_resort_status for a live, per-lift answer about one resort.

region.description: Country, state or region tag, case-insensitive

name: ski_open_now
title: Resorts open right now
